description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Ind, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, Uralic) in terms of their morphosyntactic probing capabilities. The vertical axis represents the effect, which is a measure of the model's performance, while the horizontal axis lists the Indo-European language families. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the different models, with each model's effect on a particular language family represented by a bar. The chart includes error bars to indicate the variability or confidence interval of the effect. The values on the vertical axis are not explicitly labeled, but the bars provide a visual representation of the effect size, with taller bars indicating a higher effect. The chart does not include any sorting or emphasis on specific bars, and it does not provide a legend for the color coding of the bars.
